name: Escoba
description: Escoba (Spanish for 'Broom') is the Spanish variant of Scopa, a fishing-capture game. The defining mechanic: a player captures ALL cards from the table by playing a card that, combined with the table cards, sums to exactly 15. This 'sweep' (escoba) earns bonus points. Card values: A=1, 2-7=face value, J=8, Q=9, K=10. Targets: Most cards, Most Coins, 7 of Coins (Siete Bello), and sweeps.

items.text: Scopa (Italian): Italian ancestor. Allows rank-pairing AND arithmetic sum captures. Scopa = sweep any table.
Argentine Escoba: Includes Setenta scoring. Most common in Argentina and Uruguay.
